Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice; inadvertently leaving the stove on is mere negligence, not an intentional or reckless burning.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not formally binding sources and do not always state custom; they are material sources that may enunciate customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” creates a right of entry, so the state holds a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent.
